text: Before this morning: the lady tells her fears to the man she looks to for help
why: ¶20 says the man she turns to for help has heard her fears before and treats them as fancies, so she has told him earlier.

text: That morning: the lady answers Holmes
why: The lady is speaking to Holmes in this morning's meeting (¶17–20).

text: Why can the one who cares for her be of so little aid? — he takes her fears for fancies
id: q.why_little_aid=he takes her fears for fancies
why: ¶17 says he 'can be of little aid,' and ¶20 says he treats her fears as the fancies of a nervous woman.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded?
why: A plain question the story has openly raised through her stated fears and suspicions.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded? — her fears are well founded
why: A possibility the story gives reason to consider, since she describes real dangers encompassing her (¶17, ¶20). It is not stated as fact.

text: Are the lady's fears well founded? — they are the fancies of a nervous woman
id: q.fears_real=they are the fancies of a nervous woman
why: ¶20 states this view directly, so the reader has reason to weigh it.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of?
why: A plain question the lady's talk of 'dangers' and 'dense darkness' gives reason to ask.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — someone would lose her income when she marries
id: q.danger_cause=someone would lose her income when she marries
why: ¶17 mentions her marriage in a month or six weeks and her 'control of my own income,' so the link between marriage and income is a possibility the story has raised. This is a close call, but it is a possibility, not a stated fact.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — the marriage itself is the danger
id: q.danger_cause=the marriage itself is the danger
why: The story ties her coming marriage to her plea for help and to the dangers she fears (¶17), so the possibility that marriage is the danger is one a reader could consider. This is a close call.

text: What lies behind the dangers the lady speaks of? — the danger has nothing to do with her money
id: q.danger_cause=the danger has nothing to do with her money
why: A possibility the reader can reasonably weigh, given that money has just been raised in ¶17 and the danger is still unexplained.
